title: Hail
tldr: Get indoors and stay away from windows during hail. If driving, stop in a safe place out of traffic when you can; stay inside the vehicle and protect yourself from broken glass. Do not stop beneath a highway overpass.
steps: Move into a sturdy building before collecting possessions.
Use an interior room and keep pets inside.
Pull over safely out of traffic, avoid flood-prone areas and remain in the vehicle.
Hail can accompany tornadoes, lightning and strong wind; act on those warnings as well.
next: Check for injuries and roof or window damage only when conditions are safe. Photograph damage from ground level.
watch: Do not climb a wet or damaged roof to inspect it.
review_status: source-linked editorial review; not independent expert certification
without_help: Remain under substantial shelter while hail continues. Keep shoes on and avoid glazing. Afterward, assess damage from the ground; loose roofing and hidden electrical damage can be more dangerous than the hail itself.
household: Account for children, older people, pets and anyone who needs assistance before moving. Keep shoes, medicines and a torch in the shelter area. Decide who helps whom and who carries the essential supplies; do not send a lone child to retrieve items. For this situation, brief every person on the first action: leave the open. Agree who will manage children, pets or mobility needs while that action happens. Do not climb a wet or damaged roof to inspect it.
pack_now: For hail, prioritize only items needed for the first action and the fallback: Remain under substantial shelter while hail continues. Keep shoes on and avoid glazing. Afterward, assess damage from the ground; loose roofing and hidden electrical damage can be more dangerous than the hail itself. Keep the relevant checklist and contact information within reach. Equipment retrieval must not delay the protective step.
scope: Civilian educational guidance. Linked references may use U.S. emergency systems; local warning methods, laws, services and conditions differ.
